title: Recipe 72 — Zero to self-improving: your usage becomes the benchmark

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “The whole arc in one sitting: an empty directory to an agent that measurably improves from your own usage.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed ghostwriter is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — every stage past the compile gate is billed.

groups.title: Beat 1 · the spec you start with

beats.label: Type the ghostwriter
beats.cue: “Twenty-eight lines and no evals, no dataset, no ratings. Hour zero, honestly.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean — and completely unmeasured. That's the gap the rest of the recipe closes.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated at the model credential. A working agent, with nothing to prove it's any good.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Scaffold the eval assets
beats.cue: “Recipe 61's first verb, applied here: a dataset skeleton and graders, derived from the spec itself.”

verify.note: writes a starting dataset + graders pair

beats.label: List what it wrote
beats.cue: “Two files, thirty seconds in. There is now something to regress against.”

beats.label: Read the list
beats.cue: “Scaffolded, not authored. You'll grow both from real usage — that's the next stage.”

beats.label: Check the registry
beats.cue: “Still empty. Scaffolding gives you the shape; only usage gives you the content.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “The honest hour-one state, on camera.”

groups.title: Beat 3 · use it, rate it, distill it

beats.label: Run the ghostwriter
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Use it for real. The benchmark is going to be made out of these turns.”

verify.note: interactive REPL; needs a model credential

beats.label: Give it the recipe's own task
beats.cue: [needs-key] “A real task with a tone you have opinions about — that's what makes the rating meaningful.”
beats.text: Draft a reply to Sam: I can't make Thursday, propose Monday or Tuesday instead.

beats.label: Exit
beats.cue: [needs-key] “exit” returns to the shell.

beats.label: Say what was wrong with it
beats.cue: [needs-key] “'never open with I hope this finds you well' — one sentence, and it becomes a grader.”
beats.command: crewhaus feedback --session <session-id> --text "never open with 'I hope this finds you well'"

verify.note: needs a real session id from the run above

beats.label: Distill it into a dataset
beats.cue: [needs-key] “--register names it. From here on, that name IS your benchmark.”

groups.title: One more thing · close the loop and keep it closed

beats.label: Eval against your own taste
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Not a public benchmark. Yours.”

verify.note: needs the registered dataset and a model credential

beats.label: Read the run history
beats.cue: “Empty now — but this is the command that later tells you whether last week's change helped.”

verify.note: no recorded runs yet — the honest empty state

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “A baseline you can regress against is the difference between improving and just changing.”

beats.label: Optimize against the ratings
beats.cue: [needs-key] “--ratings all --write: the loop closes, and only a measured win lands in the spec.”

verify.note: billed on candidate and judge; --write patches the spec on a win

beats.label: Make it nightly
beats.cue: [manual] “flywheel init writes the CI workflow. Review it before it lands — it will be running unattended.”
